observations: body: the page has no printed number. The head ornament is a rule 2.16 pt thick over a border of 33 equal sorts (a beaded bar, a lyre of two curled scrolls round a stem, side leaves and a hanging leaf), 422.6 pt wide in the print. It is redrawn from the print (figures/AB01-PDF0422-F01.tex): the sort is the mean of its 33 printed copies, traced and set at the pitch fitted to them (12.80 pt), and the rule is drawn between the ends of its ink; on the leaf the band falls 1.3 pt from left to right and is drawn straight; it is enlarged in the ratio of the measures (532.9 to 424.4 pt), as the display lines.

body L1-L2: «PRAEFATIO» is letter-spaced; its face is not imitated and the line is scaled to the box of the printed line. A dot to the upper right of the O (2.2 by 2.0 pt, level with the tops of the capitals) is a speck, not a stop. The rule under the title is 63.6 pt long and 0.48 pt thick, printed broken in three places; it is drawn whole.
body L2-L3: the summary of the three sections is set in a smaller bold type (x-height 4.4 pt against 5.2 pt in the text), its second line indented 23 pt; the dashes measure 7.4 and 8.0 pt.
body L2-L4: «§ 1.» in L4 is bold; its figure 1 has a short flag and resembles an I (the bold figures of «§ 2» and «§ 3» in L2-L3 are of the same type). The dash after it measures 10.1 pt.

body L8: the comma after «edere» prints with a short tail (1.8 pt high, its foot 0.3 pt below the baseline; the other commas of the page reach 1.0-1.4 pt below it); the stops of the page end above the baseline.

body L13, L22: the dashes of «Arabico–occidentalibus» (about 6 pt) and «Arabico–orientali» (4.2 pt) are long dashes; the o of «Arabico» in L22 prints broken. The hyphen of «al-Battānī» measures 3.4 pt.

body L15-L20: the list is printed in two columns, each letter set before its numeral value and the letters with which the codex confuses it. The letters keep the forms of the Maghribi script of the codex: «ڢ‍ 80» is the fā with one dot below and «ف‍ 100» the qāf with one dot above (transcribed with the Eastern fā, as in the notes on the tables, S07); in parentheses stand the forms without their dots (the dotless bā, the zāy without its dot, the initial tooth without its dots) and, in the last row of the right column, the medial fā with its dot below beside the dotless «‍ڡ‍». «ى 10» is the final yā without dots. Initial forms are transcribed with a zero-width joiner after the letter (ي‍, ٮ‍, ل‍, ن‍, ڢ‍, ف‍, ك‍), medial forms with one on each side (‍ع‍, ‍ڡ‍, ‍ڢ‍). The letters standing first in each row are set flush right before the rest of the row, as printed.
body L25: the letters of «Nam س 60, ص 90, ف 80, ض 800, ظ 900» are the Eastern forms with al-Battānī's values, read on the scan at 600 dpi.
body L27: the n of «adǹ.» carries a mark in the form of a grave accent (1.8 by 1.6 pt, 1 pt above the letter), transcribed as printed; the abbreviation prints without it on pp. VI and VIII.
body: the stamp of the owning library at the foot of the page (FEB 23 1909, 237439), the pencil marks beside it and the mark of the digitization are not part of the print and are not transcribed.
